lines.text: He has one life left... and it's right behind him.
lines.cap: He has *one life* left... and it's *right behind him.*

lines.text: Two hours earlier, Jay was on Pulsebox with his best friend Maya on the headset.
lines.cap: *Two hours earlier,* Jay was on Pulsebox with his best friend Maya on the headset.

lines.text: One more game, then I'm going to sleep.
lines.cap: One more game, then I'm going to sleep.

lines.text: Then a mode showed up that neither of them had ever seen.
lines.cap: Then a mode showed up that neither of them had *ever seen.*

lines.text: Three games. One life. No saves.
lines.cap: *Three games. One life. No saves.*

lines.text: One life? Easy. Let's go.
lines.cap: One life? Easy. Let's go.

lines.text: Would you press start? Comment yes or no.
lines.cap: Would you press start? Comment *yes or no.*

lines.text: He pressed it. His room went dark... and his screen became a windshield.
lines.cap: He pressed it. His room went *dark...* and his screen became a *windshield.*

lines.text: Game one: Getaway Heat. Three stars. Every cop in the city on his tail.
lines.cap: Game one: *Getaway Heat.* Three stars. Every cop in the city on his tail.

lines.text: Jay, they're right behind you!
lines.cap: Jay, they're *right behind you!*

lines.text: Except the cop cars didn't have drivers.
lines.cap: Except the cop cars didn't have *drivers.*

lines.text: Then a truck jackknifed across the road.
lines.cap: Then a truck *jackknifed* across the road.

lines.text: Hold on. Hold on!
lines.cap: Hold on. *Hold on!*

lines.text: So he went under it.
lines.cap: So he went *under it.*

lines.text: Game two: Lights Out Motel. Jay's the night clerk. One rule: only give keys to humans.
lines.cap: Game two: *Lights Out Motel.* Jay's the night clerk. One rule: only give keys to *humans.*

lines.text: At three AM, someone knocked on the glass.
lines.cap: At *3 AM,* someone knocked on the glass.

lines.text: Jay? It's me, Maya. It's freezing out here. Give me a key.
lines.cap: Jay? It's me, *Maya.* It's freezing out here. Give me a key.

lines.text: Maya... you're on my headset.
lines.cap: Maya... you're on my *headset.*

lines.text: Jay, I'm at home. That's not me.
lines.cap: Jay, I'm at home. *That's not me.*

lines.text: Her smile didn't move. Her eyes didn't blink.
lines.cap: Her smile didn't move. Her eyes *didn't blink.*

lines.text: Would you give her the key? Comment it.
lines.cap: Would you give her the key? *Comment it.*
lines.prompt: WOULD YOU GIVE HER THE KEY?

lines.text: He slammed the shutter. And her smile... kept getting wider.
lines.cap: He slammed the shutter. And her smile... kept getting *wider.*

lines.text: Game three: Rooftop Rush. A drone on his tail...
lines.cap: Game three: *Rooftop Rush.* A drone on his tail...

lines.text: and the thing from the motel, climbing after him.
lines.cap: ...and the thing from the motel, *climbing after him.*

lines.text: Run, Jay! It's right behind you!
lines.cap: Run, Jay! It's *right behind you!*

lines.text: Then came the biggest gap in the game.
lines.cap: Then came the *biggest gap* in the game.

lines.text: Did he make it? Comment before you find out.
lines.cap: Did he make it? *Comment before you find out.*

lines.text: His fingers caught the edge.
lines.cap: His fingers *caught the edge.*

lines.text: Run complete. One life left.
lines.cap: Run complete. *One life left.*

lines.text: Jay woke up at his desk. Sunrise. The headset was still on.
lines.cap: Jay woke up at his desk. Sunrise. The headset was *still on.*

lines.text: Maya! You saved me last night.
lines.cap: Maya! You saved me last night.

lines.text: Jay... I went to sleep at ten. I was never on.
lines.cap: Jay... I went to sleep at ten. I was *never on.*

lines.text: So who was on his headset all night?
lines.cap: So who was on his headset *all night?*

lines.text: Drop your theory below.
lines.cap: Drop your *theory* below.

lines.text: Jay... I'm outside. Open the door.
lines.cap: Jay... I'm outside. *Open the door.*

lines.text: Pulsebox. Seventy-seven free games: racing, horror, heists, sports, and more.
lines.cap: *Pulsebox.* 77 free games: racing, horror, heists, sports and more.

lines.cap: Free at... *box.pulseform.org.* Play it on a *computer.*

lines.cap: Tag the friend you'd trust on your headset... *if you still do.*
